data.name: Chains of Vithra
data.detailed_description:
"In a shattered realm of eternal danger and crumbling stone, Chains of Vithra invites you into a brutal dark RPG set in the war-torn world of Drakis. Long ago, a group of elves was born with a cursed deformity—four arms, mirroring their greatest enemy, the mighty dragon Nepenthis. Shunned and cast out by their kin, these outcasts endured centuries of hardship, eventually forging themselves into the formidable High Elves. A dark god seized upon their suffering, twisting their will to serve his ambition: total dominion over Drakis. To achieve this, he demands the construction of massive pyramids from the rare and powerful Dark Quarry stone—requiring endless slave labor from every other race. The lands north of the mighty River of Pain have already fallen to the High Elves' conquest. Now their forces press against the last free human kingdom in the south. As one of the survivors in this devastated world, your journey begins in a classic action-adventure RPG style. You must stay alive, grow in power, restore fragile trust between the human kingdom and the Dwarven realms to the south, and forge unlikely alliances—including with the Orcs driven into the swamplands by the invading High Elves. Explore vast seamless landscapes filled with monsters displaced by the wars, shadowed city hubs teeming with intrigue, and dangerous regions such as orcish territories and murky swamps. Travel across crumbling ruins, monster-infested wilds, and faction-controlled zones as you undertake missions to unite fractured races and halt the High Elves' advance. Forge a tormented hero through deep, ruthless character progression. Level your character from 1 to 30 in this opening chapter of a greater storyline, customizing your build with skills, abilities, stats, and equipment. The game features a rich skill and ability system where combat and non-combat skills can be leveled through use, unlocking powerful effects, passives, and synergies. Engage in visceral tactical combat against overwhelming odds. Battles emphasize positioning, ability timing, resource management (health, mana, stamina, and more), and environmental awareness. Face challenging foes, from displaced beasts to High Elf enforcers, in both solo and group encounters. The persistent world allows you to fight alongside other players for tougher challenges, share resources, or compete for control of key areas. Built on a MMORPG framework, expect a living, persistent online world with:

  • Vast exploration of regions and instanced content (dungeons, cities, or private areas)

  • Dynamic quest systems with meaningful choices and branching paths

  • Faction standings that influence alliances, trade, and story outcomes

  • Inventory, crafting, trading, and auction house systems

  • Social features including chat, grouping, and long-term player interactions

Harrowing moral choices, brutal survival elements, and the constant threat of the High Elves' expansion create a grim atmosphere where every decision matters. Restore hope through diplomacy and strength, or watch the River of Pain become the final barrier before total subjugation. This is the first chapter (levels 1-30) of an epic dark fantasy saga. Additional content, story arcs, and features will expand the world over time in this ongoing multiplayer experience. Gender: Dark Fantasy RPG / Action-Adventure CRPG 
Playtime: 30-40+ hours for the core storyline and exploration (varies with multiplayer and side content)
Key Features: Deep character progression, tactical combat, vast world, faction alliances, meaningful choices, rich lore-driven narrative. Will you unite the fractured races in time, or will the pyramids rise and Drakis fall forever?

data.short_description: "In a brutal, unforgiving RPG, descend into a shattered realm of massive seamless landscapes and shadowed city hubs. Forge a tormented hero through ruthless progression, engage in visceral tactical combat, and make harrowing choices that shape a grim, persistent multiplayer world."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: I-5 8th Gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 4060 / RX 7600 series (or equivalents)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built in
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i-9 - 14900hx, 2200 Mhz, 24 core
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB or AMD Radeon RX 9070 (16GB) or RX 9060 XT 16GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built in

content_descriptors.notes: Chains of Vithra is a PG-13 high-fantasy game. It contains no sexual content, no nudity, no depictions of sexual acts, no sexual assault or non-consensual themes, no drug or alcohol abuse, and no self-harm. The game features fantasy violence typical of classic medieval-style elf-versus-dwarf storytelling. Players will engage in combat against enemy forces and dark creatures such as vampires and ghouls. These encounters include depictions of battle, injury, and defeat of foes with mild blood effects and fantasy combat violence consistent with a PG-13 rating. The strongest language used in the entire game is the word “Scum” when referring to enemies. A portion of the storyline involves a plague. This includes narrative themes of disease, suffering, loss, and mortality. These elements are presented in a story-driven context without graphic or exploitative detail. All mature content is kept mild and appropriate for a PG-13 audience, focusing on high-fantasy adventure with some darker atmospheric elements rather than explicit or sensationalized material.
